title: Telemetry-driven canary controller for Private control plane upgrades
creator: Priya Natarajan
description: Implement a telemetry-driven Canary Controller and associated Terraform/IaC changes to automate Private (VPC) control plane version rollouts. The controller will use live SLO/health metrics and contract test results to advance, pause, or rollback canary cohorts. This ticket covers design, Terraform module changes for immutable versioned control planes, integration points with the observability pipeline, and a runbook for emergency manual overrides.
acceptance_criteria: Controller can schedule a staggered canary across 5 control plane instances with configurable cohort sizes
Controller reads health signals (API error rate, median p95 latency, KV cache miss ratio) from the telemetry pipeline and computes pass/fail against configured SLOs
Automated rollback is triggered when a cohort breaches critical thresholds for more than the configured hold window
Terraform modules expose immutable controlplane_version and create canary sets without in-place mutation
Preflight contract test suite runs automatically against each canary cohort and failures prevent promotion
Canary state and decision reasons are visible in the Console rollout UI and logged to the audit stream
Manual override API allows SRE to pin, fast-forward, or abort a rollout; rollbacks create a post-mortem ticket skeleton
rollout_plan: Phase 0: feature flag + dry-run mode in staging (2 days) - controller only evaluates and logs decisions without altering traffic
Phase 1: create canary cohorts in a test VPC (3 days) - Terraform creates versioned control planes as blue/green sets
Phase 2: enable telemetry gating with conservative SLOs (4 days) - 5% traffic to cohort A, 0% to others
Phase 3: gradual promotion with auto-adjust (7 days) - cohort sizes 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% if SLOs pass
Phase 4: monitor for 72 hours at 100% then schedule GA promotion and decommission old versions
Rollback window: automatic rollback if critical SLO breached for > 10m; manual rollback triggers documented in runbook
implementation_notes: Add new Terraform module parameter 'controlplane_version' and 'canary_groups' to private/controlplane module
Module will create versioned sets named cp-v{version}-{cohort} backing the same tenant routing configuration
Controller will be implemented as a small Go service (k8s operator) that watches CRDs: ControlPlaneRollout and ControlPlaneCohort
Controller inputs: metrics from telemetry pipeline (Prometheus/OTel as primary), results from contract-test-runner (HTTP summary), and IAM policy for manual overrides
Decision engine: sliding-window SLO evaluator with weighted signals (default weights: error_rate 0.5, p95_latency 0.3, kv_miss 0.2) and hysteresis to avoid flapping
Expose feature flag 'telemetry_canary_v1' to gate rollout to internal tenants only until GA
Audit events must include decision_reason, metric_snapshot, and commit_sha of the controlplane image
Add unit and e2e tests: simulate metric spikes and contract failures to verify rollback logic
risks_mitigation: Risk: false positives from noisy telemetry -> Mitigation: use median and percentile smoothing, require >2 different signals to indicate failure
Risk: Terraform drift between versioned sets -> Mitigation: module creates immutable resource names, reconciliation job compares desired vs actual and raises alerts
Risk: incomplete contract tests allowing regressions -> Mitigation: expand contract suite to include critical admin APIs and KV behavior; block promotion on any test failure
Risk: controller bug causing accidental mass promotion -> Mitigation: initial rollout behind feature flag and limited to internal tenants; require operator review for multi-tenant promotion
Risk: security/permission escalation through manual override API -> Mitigation: require RBAC role 'sre:canary-override' and Kerberos/SSO audit trail
